messages:
nora: Quick check  were sending offer emails tomorrow and want to include the canonical orientation link. Which URL should we use so recipients in LATAM/EMEA/APAC get the right recording?
onboard-bot: Orientation event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orient-main-24  recording auto-attaches to event and copies to Drive:/onboarding/recordings.
lee: Use the calendar event URL as canonical. After the session we generate a short bundle (slides + 20m quick-watch + transcript) and post a one-click shortlink. I can create the shortlink within 30m of upload.
samir: Heads up for LATAM hires: some mail clients in Brazil/Argentina show the invite in local TZ but drop DST offsets, which caused a few duplicates last cycle. Ops produced a TZ-fixed .ics specifically for LATAM users.
claire: Can we get a one-paragraph blurb for offers? Also want to tell people where captions/transcripts will be.
lee: Draft blurb: "Join New Hire Orientation (9:00 PT). Use the calendar link to join live. Slides and recordings (full + 20m quick-watch) will be attached to the event and saved to our onboarding Drive folder. If you cannot attend, watch the quick-watch and join the follow-up Q&A. Note: do NOT import the .ics if you already accepted via Google Calendar (it can create duplicates)."
nora: Perfect. Two more: 1) will there be region-friendly replays for APAC? 2) can we request Spanish captions?
onboard-bot: APAC replay event created: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orient-apac-24 at 09:00 AEST. Spanish captions: we auto-generate EN captions and run auto-translate; for verified Spanish captions DM @lee with names and we can human-verify for the reply.
samir: Also, small bug report: Outlook mobile sometimes shows a duplicated event if the .ics is imported while the Google invite exists. Recommend including a bold line in the description: "If you accepted via Google Calendar do not import .ics." Ops will also publish a TZ-fixed .ics per region.
claire: Great. When the shortlink is ready can you ping me? Ill paste it in offer packets and the welcome email.
lee: Will do  Ill post the shortlink to this thread once the recording is processed. :thumbsup:
nora: Thanks all  that covers it. If anyone still has timezone oddities, DM me the event ID and your local TZ and @samir will produce a region .ics.
